says: In today's lead tooling, the unlisted-branch scan stops when a branch has no shared history with main, so it produces no report for the remaining branches.
proof: At main 55ae19989916bacf063c1e418f72869fe1891957, the scan exits 1 with 'refusing to merge unrelated histories'. The retained tip 8f64088c53f4eb4c97c2ada470e39f0a7024496a has no merge base with main. git merge-tree --write-tree main <tip> exits 128, while BranchesGit.landsEmpty accepts only 0 or 1. Unlisted.check propagates that failure instead of reporting that branch as unlisted.
cost: One unrelated branch prevents the lead from seeing which other branches still need a pull request.
head: 55ae19989916bacf063c1e418f72869fe1891957
